INNER HEAD. [3] [Aurant.]
Hemicrania ; right side.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Aurant.]
Constant toothache.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Aurant.]
Pains in kidneys and bladder.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Aurant.]
Too copious menses.
Painful menstruation (tincture of seed of lemons).
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Aurant.]
Pleurodynia.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Aurant.]
Palpitation.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Aurant.]
Sciatica.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Aurant.]
Painful joints.
Trembling of limbs.
Cold limbs when traveling.
   

NERVES. [36] [Aurant.]
Lameness.
Half-sided epileptiform convulsions, especially of face and shoulders.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Aurant.]
Diseases of old men, especially with coldness and chilliness.
